channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Equities: Mixed reaction to US-Iran tensions – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank’s Jim Reid highlights that Asian equities are mostly lower as investors digest a sharp escalation in US-Iran tensions and surging Oil prices. KOSPI is down over 5% and the Nikkei and S&P/ASX 200 are weaker, while mainland Chinese indices and the Hang Seng are firmer on tech gains.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar: Hawkish RBNZ but kiwi seen vulnerable – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur reports the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) lifted the Official Cash Rate (OCR) to 2.5%, with the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) gaining slightly versus US Dollar (USD).

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Sustenance above 20-day EMA backs further upside above 1.3400
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades almost flat at around 1.3355 during the European trading session on Wednesday. The Cable consolidates as investors await the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) minutes of the June policy meeting, which will be published at 18:00 GMT.

item.title: Euro: Range trade around key supports against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang highlights EUR/USD’s failure to extend its recent advance, with momentum fading after a retreat from recent highs.

item.title: AUD/JPY Price Forecast: Edges higher above 112.50 as mildly bullish bias persists
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross gathers strength to around 112.70 during the early European session on Wednesday. Nonetheless, renewed tensions between the US and Iran, and fears of possible intervention by Japanese authorities might support the Japanese Yen (JPY) and cap the upside for the cross.

item.title: China lifts July fuel export restrictions for July — Reuters
item.description: China has lifted refined fuel export restrictions for July and allowed a private refiner ‌to resume shipments after a four-month pause, Reuters reported on Wednesday, as the world’s biggest refiner returns toward normal after disruptions from the Iran war.

item.title: Euro gains as US Dollar moves sideways amid market caution
item.description: EUR/USD maintains its position after registering modest losses in the previous day, trading around 1.1410 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Indian Rupee edges up against US Dollar, ignores rising oil prices
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) ticks higher against the US Dollar (USD) in the opening session on Wednesday. The USD/INR pair edges down to near 95.00 despite renewed geopolitical risks, following United States (US) attacks on Iran, which have lifted oil prices.

item.title: Gold retains positive bias above $4,100; upside seem limited ahead of FOMC Minutes
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) sticks to its modest intraday gains above the $4,100 mark through the Asian session on Wednesday and, for now, seems to have snapped a two-day losing streak, reaching the weekly trough touched the previous day.

item.title: NZD/USD Price Forecast: Sticks to hawkish RBNZ-led gains to 0.5710-0.5715 confluence
item.description: The NZD/USD pair gains strong positive traction following the Reserve Bank of New Zealand's (RBNZ) first rate hike in three years and reclaims the 0.5700 mark during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: Silver climbs above $60.00 despite US–Iran tensions, Fed minutes in focus
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) attracts some buyers to near $60.35, snapping the two-day losing streak during the early European session on Wednesday. The white metal edges higher amid a softer US Dollar (USD) ahead of the release of the June FOMC meeting Minutes.

item.title: India Gold price today: Gold rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices rose in India on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah holds losses following Consumer Confidence data
item.description: USD/IDR gains ground after registering modest losses in the previous day, trading around 18,050 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: WTI holds above $72.00, near two-week high amid fresh US-Iran tensions
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – struggles to capitalize on the previous day's strong move up and enters a bullish consolidation phase near a two-week high, touched during the Asian session this Wednesday.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Hawkish remarks from RBA’s Hunter lift Australian Dollar
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades 0.23% higher to near 0.6943 against the US Dollar (USD) during the Asian trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: Iran’s IRGC: Targeted 85 US military sites in Bahrain, Kuwait after ceasefire breach
item.description: The Iranian Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) said on Wednesday that it “targeted 85 US military sites in Bahrain and Kuwait following the US ceasefire breach.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Rebounds above confluence around 185.00, moving averages
item.description: EUR/JPY pares its recent losses from the previous day, trading around 185.30 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Breman Speech: RBNZ Governor speaks on policy outlook after raising interest rate
item.description: Reserve Bank of New Zealand’s (RBNZ) Governor Anna Breman presents the prepared remarks on the Monetary Policy Review (MPR) and responds to media questions at the press conference after the July monetary policy announcement.

item.title: Swiss Franc weakens as US Dollar advances on renewing US-Iran tensions
item.description: USD/CHF extends its gains for the third successive day, trading around 0.8090 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The pair appreciates as the Greenback receives support from safe-haven demand amid renewing geopolitical tensions.

item.title: Iran's Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf accuses US of violating MoU
item.description: Iran's top negotiator Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf accuses the United States (US), through a post on X, formerly known as Twitter, of violating major terms of the memorandum of understanding (MoU) signed for a ceasefire in the Middle East.

item.title: United States Dollar Index holds above 101.00 following US strikes on Iran
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is holding gains for the second consecutive day and trading around 101.10 during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar advances as RBNZ hike weighs on AUD/NZD
item.description: AUD/NZD declines after three days of gains, trading around 1.2170 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency cross falls nearly 0.25% as the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) gains ground following the release of the interest rate decision by the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ).

item.title: New Zealand Dollar rallies to 0.5700 vs USD on expected RBNZ rate hike
item.description: The NZD/USD pair attracts some buyers in reaction to the Reserve Bank of New Zealand's (RBNZ) anticipated interest rate hike and reclaims the 0.5700 mark during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: British Pound declines to near 1.3350 as US launches strikes on Iran
item.description: The GBP/USD pair loses traction to near 1.3355 during the Asian trading hours on Wednesday. The US Dollar (USD) edges higher against the British Pound (GBP) amid renewed geopolitical tensions after the US renewed strikes on Iran.

item.title: XAG/USD Price Forecast: Defends bearish flag support near mid-$59.00s
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) trades with a negative bias for the third straight day and hovers around the $59.80 region during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: Canadian Dollar declines as safe-haven demand lifts US Dollar
item.description: USD/CAD inches higher after registering minor losses in the previous day, trading around 1.4200 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Euro struggles above 1.1400 as fresh US strikes on Iran support USD ahead of FOMC Minutes
item.description: The EUR/USD pair defends the 1.1400 mark during the Asian session on Wednesday, though it struggles to attract any meaningful buyers on the back of renewed US-Iran hostilities.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.8077 vs. 6.8054 previous
item.description: On Wednesday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.8077 compared to the previous day's fix of 6.8054 and 6.8018 Reuters estimate.

item.title: RBA’s Hunter: Board will intervene as necessary to bring inflation back to target
item.description: Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) Assistant Governor Sarah Hunter said on Wednesday that the central bank will act as needed to bring inflation back to target, even as the recent oil shock has yet to produce a marked slowdown in economic activity.

item.title: WTI spikes following fresh US airstrikes on Iran
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price continues to advance after registering nearly 5% gains in the previous day, trading around $72.20 per barrel during the Asian hours on Wednesday.
